facts.fact: UNICEF Innocenti says Chad's EMIS has routinely collected data from schools since 2009, analysed centrally with a statistical yearbook produced annually.
UNICEF Innocenti says decentralisation of the EMIS is already effective in 16 provinces and is to be extended to seven others under the PRET.
